source.title: Hinterlands Mission II: Defeat Giant Turtles
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shaol'watha. Defeat giant turtles there and return to me.
source.objective: Defeat 20 Dreamwater Visejaw in the Hinterlands Nightmare Incursion at Shaol'watha and return to Field Captain Korlian.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
